results.note: De VII artibus (Seven Liberal Arts): No English translation found. While the seven liberal arts themselves are documented, this specific medieval treatise on the subject appears untranslated.
De musica I: No English translation found for this anonymous medieval music theory treatise, despite searches for both this specific work and general medieval De musica texts.
De musica II: No English translation found for this second part of an anonymous medieval music treatise.
De praelatione Didaci Gelmiridae: No English translation found for this obscure medieval ecclesiastical text concerning a clerical prelate.
De revelatione aedificatione et auctoritate Fiscannensis monasterii: No English translation found for this medieval monastic history.
Dissolutio Dalmatii episcopi: No English translation found for this brief medieval ecclesiastical text regarding a bishop's removal.
Dypticha ecclesiae Arelatensis: No English translation found for this church roster/diptych from Arles.
Epistola ad Heribertum Coloniensem: No English translation found for this medieval letter, despite searches in epistolary databases and medieval letter collections.
Epistola ad Odericum Vindocinensem: No English translation found for this brief medieval letter.
Excerpta ex liturgicis codicibus Fontavellanensibus: No English translation found for these liturgical excerpts from Fontanelle Abbey manuscripts.

Forma excommunicationis: Medieval excommunication formulas exist in various forms (including some Middle English versions in manuscripts like British Library MS Add. 15236), but no confirmation found for an English translation of this specific PL version.
Fragmentum musices: No English translation found for this fragment of medieval music theory.
Historia translationis reliquiarum S. Maximi: No English translation found; searches reveal only references to the Latin text and its historical importance.
Mensura monochordi Boetii: No English translation found for this medieval music-theory treatise on the monochord measurement, despite documented scholarly interest in the subject.
Micrologus de ecclesiasticis observationibus: A major medieval liturgical work, but no English translation was found in available sources (German scholarship exists).
Monochordum Encheriadis: No English translation found for this brief medieval music theory treatise.
Monumenta de treuga Domini: No English translation found for these records concerning the Peace/Truce of God movement, despite modern scholarly interest in the topic.
Nomina antistitum S. Matiscensis: No English translation found for this bishop-list from Metz.
Nomina episcoporum S. Gratianopolitanae ecclesiae: No English translation found for this bishop-list from Grenoble.
Panegyricus Berengarii: No English translation found for this panegyric of the 10th-century Italian king Berengar, despite historical significance of the period.
Rhythmus satyricus: No English translation found for this medieval satirical verse composition.
Semotio Didaci primi ab episcopatu: No English translation found for this brief text on a bishop's removal.

Sequentiae: While medieval sequences as a literary form are well-documented and some individual sequences have been translated, this specific anonymous collection does not appear to have an English translation.
Sermo de S. Marculfo: No English translation found for this sermon on Saint Marculf.
Synodus habita anno 1096: No English translation found for this medieval council record. The 1096 date corresponds to post-Council of Clermont, but this specific synod text remains untranslated.
Vetus sacramentarium: The Old Gelasian Sacramentary exists in critical Latin editions (Wilson 1894, Mohlberg 1968) but no English translation was found in search results.
Epistola encyclica de obitu S. Brunonis: No English translation found for this encyclical letter on the death of Saint Bruno the Carthusian. The letter exists in Documenta Catholica Omnia in Latin.

Vita III (Bruno): Likely translated. References found to English translations of Bruno vitae through André Ravier's biographical work (translated 1995) and other Carthusian sources, but confirmation of this specific 'Vita III' version unclear.

Vita antiquior (Bruno): Likely translated. References found to English translations of Bruno's vitae in Carthusian communities and André Ravier's 1995 English translation (Ignatius Press). This being the 'older' vita suggests it may be included in compilations.
Ex historia martyrum Treverensium: No English translation found. A German translation/edition by Paul Dräger exists, but no English version was located.
Ex vita S. Agritii: No English translation found for this excerpt from the life of Saint Agritius, first historically documented bishop of Trier.
Gesta Treverorum: Deeds of Trier has a German translation/edition (Emil Zenz, 8-volume edition 1950s-60s), but no English translation was found.
De primordiis et inventione sacrae religionis Hierosolymorum: No English translation found for this medieval text on the origins and founding of Jerusalem monasticism.
Genealogia comitum Buloniensium: No English translation found for this genealogy of the counts of Boulogne, though it survives in MGH edition.
Lamentum lacrymabile: No English translation found for this 12th-century versified lamentation on crusade losses. Only word-by-word Latin-English translations available.

Narratio belli sacri: Ambiguous. Related crusade texts like Historia belli sacri have English translations in the Crusade Texts in Translation series, but confirmation of this specific text's translation status unclear.
Nota: Too fragmentary (53 words) to reliably assess translation status. Likely a brief note or rubric that may never have been translated independently.
Vita B. Idae: No English translation found for the life of Saint Ida (of Herzfeld). While scholarly works about Ida exist, this specific vita appears untranslated.

Vita B. Simonis: No English translation found for this life of Blessed Simon. Searches for Symeon the Holy Fool and other similar medieval Simon vitae did not confirm translation of this specific work.
Vita S. Geremari: No English translation found for the life of Saint Geremerus, though the text survives in MGH edition (Bruno Krusch, MGH SRM 4).
Vita S. Salabergae: No English translation found for the life of Saint Salaberga (also Sadalberga), despite its historical importance and scholarly attention.

Gesta episcoporum Tullensium: No English translation found. Similar texts like Gesta episcoporum Neapolitanorum and Cameracensium have been translated (Routledge Medieval Translations), but the Tullensium version lacks an English translation.
Analecta: No English translation found for these miscellaneous fragments or extracts.
Epitaphium triplex: No English translation found for this triple epitaph.

Chronicae Polonorum: Ambiguous. Bishop Vincentius of Cracow's Chronica Polonorum has an English translation (Darius von Güttner-Sporzyński), but this anonymous version in PL 160 may be a different chronicle. Status unclear without further verification.
